draft.text: You came in because you have been having pain, swelling, and bruising on the outer part of your ankle.
You also have numbness in your foot and toes, especially near your ankle.
You mentioned that you are limping and that it feels scary because you don't want to make it worse.
Your X-ray results show no break or fracture.
You have not had any imaging studies or neurological tests like an EMG or nerve conduction study.
You may have a soft tissue injury to your ankle, such as a sprain or strain.
The numbness in your foot and toes may be related to the injury, but we do not know for sure yet.
We are waiting on the full treatment plan.
This will likely include further evaluation and management of your soft tissue injury and numbness.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you hurt your ankle while mountain biking.
You twisted your ankle and heard a crack or crackle sound.
You have pain, swelling, and bruising on the outside of your ankle.
You can't put weight on it.
You also feel numbness in your foot and toes, especially on the outside near your ankle.
You don't have tingling or weakness.
We didn't do any tests or measurements during this visit.
You may have a soft tissue injury in your ankle.
There's no sign of a broken bone or other bone problem.
The numbness in your foot and toes might be related to the injury.
We are waiting on the full treatment plan.
More evaluation and care for the injury and numbness will be discussed.
